title: Pre-launch combined polish (Steps 3+4+5) — UX copy, states, error recovery, and performance (no React Query setup changes)

requirements.summary: Ship a single cohesive UX/copy and UI refinement pass across Home, Insights, Memories, Activities, and Us with consistent English text and no confusing empty areas.
acceptanceCriteria: All five tabs (Home/Insights/Memories/Activities/Us) have consistent, understandable user-facing text in English.
No pages show confusing blank/empty sections without a helpful empty-state message.
The update ships as a single change-set (no multi-step rollout required).

file_operations.description: Create shared UI building blocks for consistent section headers + empty-state messaging copy (e.g., title, description, next-step guidance) to be reused across tabs. Use shadcn-ui primitives (Card/Button/Badge/etc.) for consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Standardize user-facing copy (headings, helper text, and section labels) to match the rest of the app, and replace any implicit/blank areas with explicit, friendly messaging using the shared DataStates components. Use shadcn-ui primitives consistently; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Unify top-level headings/subtitles and section microcopy (history, badges, harmony) so it matches the tone and terminology used across other tabs; ensure any section that can be absent has explicit explanatory text using the shared DataStates components. Use shadcn-ui primitives consistently; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align empty-state language, list labels, and action button copy with the rest of the app (same tone and next-step guidance), using the shared DataStates components. Use shadcn-ui primitives consistently; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Tighten and standardize gating text and 'coming soon' language for clarity, and ensure all gated/disabled areas explain why and what to do next using shared DataStates components. Use shadcn-ui primitives consistently; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Normalize pairing and partner-info panel copy (labels, descriptions, helper text) and ensure any missing partner data yields a clear explanation rather than partial/blank UI using shared DataStates components. Use shadcn-ui primitives consistently; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harmonize quiz-page copy (loading, waiting-for-partner, synced banners, retry phrasing) with the tone used across tabs, ensuring clarity and consistency. Use shadcn-ui primitives consistently; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add/standardize loading and empty states for key data-driven surfaces without changing React Query setup/provider configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: While data is loading, the UI shows a consistent skeleton/spinner/loading copy instead of flashing empty content.
When data is legitimately absent (e.g., no history yet, not paired yet), the UI shows a clear empty-state with next-step guidance.
No modifications are made to QueryClientProvider placement, QueryClient instantiation, or global React Query defaults.

file_operations.description: Extend shared states to include a consistent LoadingState variant (spinner/skeleton + short English label) and an inline EmptyState variant suitable for lists/panels (history, photos, partner info, quiz panels). Use shadcn-ui primitives for consistent visuals; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Use query-provided loading flags to show consistent loading states for insights metrics/cards and badges sections; show empty-state guidance when trend/badges data is absent (without flashing zeros as if they were real). Use the shared DataStates components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Standardize loading states for daily ritual prompt, ritual history list, and per-photo rendering (photo loading vs missing photo) to avoid blank gaps; show helpful empty-state guidance when history is empty. Use the shared DataStates components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace any ad-hoc loading/empty patterns with shared loading + empty states for the memories list and photo rendering, ensuring users always see an explanation for absence. Use the shared DataStates components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add/standardize loading and empty states for partner info panels and love-language sync panels (combined quiz state), ensuring 'loading' does not show as blank content. Use the shared DataStates components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure loading results/combined state shows a consistent loading surface; ensure 'waiting for partner' and 'no saved results' are clear, explicit empty states rather than silent fallback. Use the shared DataStates components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Standardize gated/locked states (not paired, quiz incomplete) with consistent empty/guidance messaging across activity packs and spin wheel sections (no ambiguous disabled UI). Use the shared DataStates components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Polish error handling and recovery UX for failed canister calls with clear English messages and safe retry actions, without removing existing/legacy code paths.
acceptanceCriteria: When a canister call fails, the user sees an English error message that explains what happened at a high level and offers a retry where appropriate.
No existing code paths are removed; any new logic is additive or guarded so older behavior remains available.
User flows do not get stuck in a perpetual loading state after an error.

file_operations.description: Add a shared ErrorState UI pattern that supports: brief English explanation, optional technical details toggle (optional), and an optional retry action callback for safe recovery. Use shadcn-ui primitives (Card/Button) for consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add additive/guarded error recovery for pairing flows (create code / connect) by presenting clear error banners and providing a retry action without removing existing toast/error logic; ensure errors always clear pending/loading UI. Use the shared ErrorState where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Improve failed ritual submission and photo upload recovery UX: show a clear error message, keep the form usable, and provide a retry affordance (e.g., re-attempt submission/upload) without removing existing behavior. Use the shared ErrorState and existing toast patterns additively; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden quiz save/reset and fetch failures: show a clear in-page error state with a safe retry (refetch) action, and ensure loading flags cannot leave the UI stuck. Keep existing banners/toasts; only add guarded improvements. Use the shared ErrorState; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

When insights/badges fetching fails, present a clear error state with retry (refetch) and ensure sections do not silently render misleading default values; keep existing UI but gate rendering so '0' does not masquerade as real data. Use the shared ErrorState; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add explicit error handling for ritual history/photo fetch failures: show a friendly error state and allow the user to retry loading the list without breaking navigation or leaving blank spaces. Use the shared ErrorState; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply lightweight UI/performance responsiveness tweaks (no React Query setup changes; no legacy code removal), focusing on reducing re-renders and avoiding scroll-janking animations.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating between tabs feels responsive and avoids noticeable UI jank on common interactions (scrolling lists, opening modals/details, submitting forms).
No React Query provider/client configuration is changed as part of performance work.
No legacy/older code paths are removed as part of cleanup.

file_operations.description: Reduce unnecessary re-renders by memoizing derived arrays/objects (historyData, milestoneBadges, achievedBadges, nextBadge, sharedLanguages) and by avoiding re-creating heavy computed structures on every render; keep behavior identical and changes additive/guarded.

Improve responsiveness for list/modal usage by minimizing work during render (e.g., memoize mapped history entries where safe, avoid repeated date formatting where possible, and ensure completion animation does not cause scroll jank). Keep existing flows intact (additive changes only).

Optimize list rendering for long histories (load more) by limiting repeated computations per item (e.g., memoize formatting helpers where appropriate) and ensuring expand/collapse does not trigger unnecessary parent re-renders.

Add lightweight CSS safeguards for responsiveness: respect prefers-reduced-motion for high-activity animations, and adjust any background/animation behaviors that can degrade scrolling (e.g., avoid scroll-janky effects on mobile). Keep changes minimal and consistent with existing theme tokens.
Ensure the completion animation is performance-friendly (e.g., reduced DOM work, respects reduced-motion preferences, avoids layout thrash) while preserving the existing visual effect.

requirements.summary: Update the existing manual QA checklist only for clarity/ordering to reflect the single combined polish verification steps (no feature changes).
acceptanceCriteria: QA covers: login/logout, profile setup, pairing flow, daily ritual completion/sync, viewing Memories/history, photo add/view/delete, love languages quiz save/reset/sync, insights viewing, and activities gating/spin wheel.
Any checklist edits are limited to clarity/ordering for the combined release and do not add new product features.

file_operations.description: Re-order and lightly edit wording to reflect the combined single-release polish verification pass: emphasize loading/empty/error-state checks across all tabs, add explicit retry/recovery checks for failed calls, and keep the same functional coverage without introducing new features.
